install: if ! command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v ffprobe >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ffmpeg; fi && pip install --no-input -q --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu torch && pip install --no-input -q numpy librosa fonttools pillow playwright faster-whisper transformers && if ! command -v hyperframes >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v elevenlabs >/dev/null 2>&1; then npm install -g hyperframes @elevenlabs/cli; fi && touch ~/.bashrc && sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc && _hf_line='if [ -z "${HYPERFRAMES_BROWSER_PATH:-}" ] && [ -d /opt/ms-playwright ]; then _hf_browser="$(find /opt/ms-playwright -maxdepth 4 -name chrome-headless-shell -type f 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true)"; if [ -n "$_hf_browser" ]; then export HYPERFRAMES_BROWSER_PATH="$_hf_browser"; fi; unset _hf_browser; fi' && (grep -qxF "$_hf_line" ~/.bashrc || printf '%s\n' "$_hf_line" >> ~/.bashrc)
